steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Sapir-Whorf hypothesis (linguistic relativity): the language we speak shapes how we think. Strong version (linguistic determinism): language completely determines thought. Weak version (linguistic relativity): language influences thought but doesn't completely determine it. | Key Fact: Piaget's view: thought precedes language. Children must understand a concept before they can use the word for it (e.g. they must understand conservation before they can talk about it). Language reflects cognitive development rather than driving it. | Key Fact: Vygotsky's view: language enables thought.
